defectsFixed.symptom: Boot spec 'command palette can be opened' timed out at 10 s under default worker fan-out; navigation.spec.ts sporadically failed under worker contention.
defectsFixed.rootCause: Default worker count (undefined → CPU-derived) over-subscribes the shared sandbox dev-server; actor-notify re-render race extends beyond 10 s under load.
defectsFixed.fix: playwright.config.ts::workers now defaults to 2 outside CI (overridable via E2E_WORKERS). e2e/boot.spec.ts adds waitForLoadState('networkidle') and extends bridge poll to 20 s.
defectsFixed.verification: 24/24 desktop, 10/10 a11y, 3/3 mobile, 1/1 tablet all PASS in single run after fix (see summary).
